verify.description: Confirm a report is real, once a source you trust says so.

mark-active.title: Active
mark-active.refusal: {name} is already active, or not yet verified
mark-active.description: Say a verified item is still happening and people should act.

mark-monitoring.title: Monitoring
mark-monitoring.refusal: {name} is already being monitored, or not yet verified
mark-monitoring.description: Say an item has gone quiet but is still worth watching.

mark-resolved.title: Resolved
mark-resolved.refusal: {name} is already resolved, or not yet verified
mark-resolved.description: Say an item is over: fixed, lifted or withdrawn.

dismiss.title: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Say a report turned out not to be real; it drops out of view but is not deleted.

back-to-reported.title: Back to reported
back-to-reported.description: Put an item back as unchecked, when what confirmed it no longer holds.

set-severity.title: Change how serious
set-severity.description: Say how serious an item is: critical, high, medium or low.

add-step-here.title: Say what to do
add-step-here.description: Add one thing people should do about this item: who, what kind of step, and how soon.

add-step.title: Add a step
add-step.description: Add something people should do, before you say which items it answers.

step-for.title: Answers an item
step-for.description: Say a step also answers another item, like one fix for two outages.
step-for.fromTheOtherEnd: Say one of our steps applies here

step-not-for.title: No longer answers
step-not-for.description: Say a step no longer applies to an item.
step-not-for.fromTheOtherEnd: Take a step off this item

edit-step.title: Edit the step
edit-step.description: Change what a step says, who it's for, or how soon it matters.

post-update.title: Post an update
post-update.description: Add what happened today to this item's timeline.

add-update.title: Add an update
add-update.description: Add something that happened on a date, before you say which item it belongs to.

update-is-about.title: Say which item
update-is-about.description: Say which item an update belongs to.
update-is-about.fromTheOtherEnd: Add an update to its timeline

update-not-about.title: Take off its item
update-not-about.description: Take an update off the item it was filed under.
update-not-about.fromTheOtherEnd: Take an update off its timeline

cite-new-source.title: Cite a new source
cite-new-source.description: Add the notice, advisory or story that says this is real.

cite.title: Cite a source
cite.description: Say a source already on the desk reports this item.
cite.fromTheOtherEnd: Say it reports one of our items

uncite.title: Drop a source
uncite.description: Say a source no longer backs this item.
uncite.fromTheOtherEnd: Say it no longer reports an item

add-source.title: Add a source
add-source.description: Add a place you hear things from: a notice, an advisory feed, a status page.

add-topic.title: Add a topic
add-topic.description: Add a part of the watch to group items by.

file-under.title: File under a topic
file-under.description: Say which topic an item falls under.
file-under.fromTheOtherEnd: File one of our items here

unfile.title: Take out of its topic
unfile.description: Take an item out of the topic it was filed under.
unfile.fromTheOtherEnd: Take an item out of here

active-says-what-to-do.title: An active item says what to do
active-says-what-to-do.description: People open the desk to learn whether to worry. An active item with no answer leaves them guessing.
active-says-what-to-do.says: {name} is active but nobody has said what to do

verified-cites-a-source.title: A verified item cites a source
verified-cites-a-source.description: Verified means someone we can point to says so.
verified-cites-a-source.says: {name} is verified but cites no source

repairs.label: It isn't confirmed; put it back

active-kept-current.title: An active item is updated every week
active-kept-current.says: {name} is active and was last updated {lastUpdated|relative}

title: Website content
pitch: Your site's pages and the words on them, from draft to review to live.

document.name: Website content
document.description: The pages of a site, the sections on each, and where every page is between draft and live.

purpose.for: A person or small team keeping a website's words up to date

jobs.name: waiting-for-review
jobs.ask: Which pages are waiting for review?

jobs.name: in-draft
jobs.ask: Which pages are still in draft?

page.description: A page of the site, like the home page, pricing or contact.

path.description: where it lives on the site, like /pricing

summary.description: the line search results and link previews show

owner.description: who keeps it up to date

reviewer.description: who reads it before it goes live

section.description: A block of words on a page: a heading and its text, a question and its answer, a feature, a quote from a customer.

order.description: where it sits on the page, lowest first

person.description: Someone who writes or reviews the site's words.

add-page.title: Add a page
add-page.description: Add a page to the site. It starts as a draft.

set-path.title: Set its address
set-path.description: Say where a page lives on the site, like /pricing.

write-summary.title: Write the summary
write-summary.description: Write the line search results and link previews show for a page.

send-for-review.title: Send for review
send-for-review.description: Say a page is ready for someone to read before it goes live.

publish.title: Publish
publish.refusal: {title} hasn't been reviewed; send it for review first
publish.description: Record that a reviewed page is live on the site, and when.

back-to-draft.title: Back to draft
back-to-draft.description: Put a page back in draft, to rework it or take it down: what a status board's move to that column does.

give-to.title: Give to someone
give-to.description: Say who keeps a page up to date, in place of whoever did.
give-to.fromTheOtherEnd: Give them one of our pages

take-off.title: Take off them
take-off.description: Take a person off a page they kept.

ask-to-review.title: Ask someone to review
ask-to-review.description: Say who reads a page before it goes live, in place of whoever was.
ask-to-review.fromTheOtherEnd: Ask them to review one of our pages

drop-reviewer.title: Drop the reviewer
drop-reviewer.description: Take the reviewer off a page.

add-section.title: Add a section
add-section.description: Add a block of words, a question or a quote before it has a page.

add-section-here.title: Add a section to this page
add-section-here.description: Add a heading and its words to this page.

write-section.title: Write it
write-section.description: Write or rewrite a section's heading and words.

set-type.title: Change what it is
set-type.description: Say whether a section is text, a question, a feature or a testimonial.

reorder.title: Move up or down
reorder.description: Say where a section sits on its page, lowest number first.

put-on-page.title: Put on a page
put-on-page.description: Say which page a section is on, in place of whichever it was.
put-on-page.fromTheOtherEnd: Put one of our sections here

take-off-page.title: Take off its page
take-off-page.description: Take a section off its page; it stays on the list.
take-off-page.fromTheOtherEnd: Take a section off this page

add-person.title: Add a person
add-person.description: Add someone who writes or reviews.

live-section-has-words.title: Nothing empty on a live page
live-section-has-words.description: A heading with nothing under it is the first thing a visitor notices.
live-section-has-words.says: {page.title} is live with an empty section: {heading}

review-has-reviewer.title: A page in review has someone reviewing it
review-has-reviewer.says: {title} is waiting for review and nobody is reviewing it

live-page-has-summary.title: A live page has a summary
live-page-has-summary.description: Without one, search results and shared links make up their own.
live-page-has-summary.says: {title} is live without a summary for search results
